title: HDD RUL — technique, métier, croisé
description: Supervision de la chaîne de prédiction de la RUL des disques durs. Source : schéma `tracing` de PostgreSQL.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(requested_at, '1m'), endpoint, count(*) AS requêtes
FROM tracing.api_requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latence p95 (ms) par endpoint
panels.description: Objectif de dimensionnement : p95 < 200 ms (cf. loadtest/PROTOCOLE.md).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(requested_at, '1m'), endpoint,
       percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM tracing.api_requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Erreurs par code HTTP
panels.description: 422 = entrée refusée par la validation, 503 = dépendance indisponible.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(requested_at, '1m'), status_code::text AS code, count(*) AS erreurs
FROM tracing.api_requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) AND status_code >= 400
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Exécutions de flows (statut)
panels.description: Suivi des flows Prefect : ingestion, lot journalier, entraînement.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT recorded_at AS "time", flow_name, status, trigger, batch_name,
       details->>'rows' AS lignes
FROM tracing.pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Version de modèle servie
panels.description: Permet de voir le basculement de version après une promotion.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model_version AS "Version", count(*) AS "Prédictions"
FROM tracing.predictions
WHERE $__timeFilter(predicted_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Lignes en quarantaine
panels.description: Règles non bloquantes du contrat de données (ex. capacity_bytes <= 0).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(recorded_at, '1h'), sum(rows) AS lignes_quarantaine
FROM tracing.quarantine
WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Disques à risque (RUL prédite < 30 j) par jour et par modèle
panels.description: Ce que l'exploitant doit traiter : les disques à remplacer en priorité. Axe : jour rejoué (indépendant de la plage de temps). Les 8 modèles les plus alertés, le reste dans « autres ».

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (
  SELECT model FROM tracing.predictions
  WHERE source = 'batch' AND alert
  GROUP BY model ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 8
)
SELECT observation_date::text AS "Jour",
       CASE WHEN model IN (SELECT model FROM top) THEN model ELSE 'autres' END AS modele,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE alert) AS a_risque
FROM tracing.predictions
WHERE source = 'batch'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Distribution des RUL prédites
panels.description: Tranches de 5 j, étiquetées par leur borne haute. Un pic à 90 j est normal : c'est la valeur « pas de panne en vue » (RUL plafonnée à l'horizon).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (LEAST(width_bucket(predicted_rul, 0, 90, 18), 18) * 5)::text AS "RUL prédite (jours)",
       count(*) AS "Disques"
FROM tracing.predictions
WHERE $__timeFilter(predicted_at)
GROUP BY LEAST(width_bucket(predicted_rul, 0, 90, 18), 18)
ORDER BY LEAST(width_bucket(predicted_rul, 0, 90, 18), 18)

panels.title: Pannes constatées par jour
panels.description: Disques tombés en panne, par jour rejoué (feedbacks automatiques du rejeu). Indépendant de la plage de temps.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT failure_date::text AS "Jour", count(DISTINCT serial_number) AS "Pannes"
FROM tracing.feedbacks
WHERE failure_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Disques scorés et alertes (cumul)
panels.description: Volume servi sur la période sélectionnée.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Disques scorés",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE alert) AS "Alertes < 30 j",
       count(DISTINCT serial_number) AS "Disques distincts"
FROM tracing.predictions
WHERE $__timeFilter(predicted_at)

panels.title: Vue croisée — qualité du modèle en production
MAE réelle en production, par version de modèle
panels.description: À comparer à la MAE de validation annoncée : dérive ou non ? Axe : jour rejoué (indépendant de la plage de temps).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.observation_date::text AS "Jour", 'v' || p.model_version AS version,
       avg(abs(p.predicted_rul - f.actual_rul)) AS mae
FROM tracing.predictions p
JOIN tracing.feedbacks f
  ON f.serial_number = p.serial_number AND f.observation_date = p.observation_date
WHERE p.source = 'batch'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: MAE réelle sur la zone critique (RUL < 30 j)
panels.description: C'est la métrique sur laquelle repose la règle de mise en service.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.observation_date::text AS "Jour", 'v' || p.model_version AS version,
       avg(abs(p.predicted_rul - f.actual_rul)) AS mae_lt30
FROM tracing.predictions p
JOIN tracing.feedbacks f
  ON f.serial_number = p.serial_number AND f.observation_date = p.observation_date
WHERE p.source = 'batch' AND f.actual_rul < 30
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: MAE de validation (MLflow) vs MAE de production, par version
panels.description: Le tableau qui justifie (ou non) une promotion ou un retour arrière.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.version AS "Version",
       v.alias AS "Alias",
       round((v.metrics->>'mae')::numeric, 3) AS "MAE validation",
       round((v.metrics->>'mae_lt30')::numeric, 3) AS "MAE validation < 30 j",
       round(avg(abs(p.predicted_rul - f.actual_rul))::numeric, 3) AS "MAE production",
       count(f.id) AS "Feedbacks"
FROM tracing.model_versions v
LEFT JOIN tracing.predictions p ON p.model_version = v.version
LEFT JOIN tracing.feedbacks f
       ON f.serial_number = p.serial_number AND f.observation_date = p.observation_date
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Erreur par modèle de disque (version servie)
panels.description: Les attributs SMART n'ont pas la même sémantique selon le constructeur.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.model AS "Modèle de disque",
       count(*) AS "Feedbacks",
       round(avg(abs(p.predicted_rul - f.actual_rul))::numeric, 3) AS "MAE"
FROM tracing.predictions p
JOIN tracing.feedbacks f
  ON f.serial_number = p.serial_number AND f.observation_date = p.observation_date
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.predicted_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 3 DESC
